answer: Each agent must earn a scarce, nontransferable reputation credential by completing randomly assigned tasks whose results are checked against independent records. A new identity starts with no credential, and repeated credentials require fresh work, not merely new keys. This makes a sybil swarm costly: the attacker must spend real time or resources on every identity and risk losing its accumulated standing if caught. The onyx, gale, and ember agents can all join, but none gets trust for free.
